name: Body and Heart
summary: In Darnassus, a young night elf druid nears the end of initiation into the path of the claw. Mathrengyl Bearwalker sends the initiate into Darkshore to summon Lunaclaw and prove strength of body and heart before taking the form of the bear.

sections.title: The Trial of Lunaclaw
sections.body: Mathrengyl Bearwalker sends night elf druid initiates east of Auberdine, the coastal settlement in Darkshore. A natural cavern there shelters wild moonkin and an ancient Moonkin Stone. Anointing the sacred stone with Cenarion Moondust awakens Lunaclaw, its ancient defender. The guardian challenges any initiate who seeks the sacred strength of the claw.

sections.title: Strength of Body and Heart
sections.body: The Great Bear Spirit teaches the first lessons of nature’s ferocity. Taking the form of the bear calls for more than brute force; Lunaclaw’s trial tests an initiate’s fortitude of heart. By defeating the guardian and heeding the spirit’s lingering wisdom, a druid proves ready to wield the bear form without losing themselves to beastly instinct.

faq.answer: Lunaclaw is an ancient moonkin guardian in a cavern east of Auberdine in Darkshore. It defends the sacred Moonkin Stone and awakens when an initiate anoints the stone with Cenarion Moondust.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this trial?
faq.answer: The trial is the final test for a night elf initiate seeking to join the Druids of the Claw. Defeating Lunaclaw proves the initiate has the physical resilience and mental composure to take on the spirit and shape of the bear.
Mathrengyl Bearwalker, an elder druid trainer in Darnassus’s Cenarion Enclave, gives initiates this trial after they have communed with the Great Bear Spirit.
Cenarion Moondust is a consecrated ritual powder given to initiates by their elders. Its magical properties awaken Lunaclaw when it is cast upon the Moonkin Stone, beginning the ritual combat.

faq.q: Where does this trial take place?
faq.answer: The trial takes place in a cavern east of Auberdine in Darkshore. Wild moonkin live around an ancient carved Moonkin Stone there.

faq.q: What happens after Lunaclaw is defeated?
faq.answer: After Lunaclaw is defeated, the Spirit of Lunaclaw appears above its physical shell and bestows a blessing, recognizing the druid’s strength of heart and body before they return to Darnassus.

angles.text: For a druid, this rite marks a defining threshold in early training. It transforms a novice spellcaster into a shapeshifting protector able to take the mighty bear form.
As a night elf, you renew ties to Cenarion customs established millennia ago by communing with ancient beast spirits and honoring sacred stones in Darkshore.
